tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
8/9

"Bitcoin had over 10 % new supply in 2013 and still rose a thousandfold."

True, but demand did that, not scarcity. TAO's halving was no starting gun either: in the week after it TAO fell 20.6 %, bitcoin rose 0.5 %.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
5/9

Now the supply. TAO copied bitcoin's plan: 21m cap, first halving at 10.5m, then 3,600 new coins a day.

Today 11.59m TAO exist. Bitcoin had that many on 20 August 2013.
→ new supply a year, TAO   11.2 %
→ bitcoin today          0.82 %

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
1/9

Bittensor's TAO has a 21 million cap and halvings, just like bitcoin. This year TAO is up 40 %, bitcoin is down 2 %.

So how scarce is TAO really, measured against bitcoin? The answer is in the blocks. 🧵
